summary: Software developer with over 7 years of experience building end-to-end web applications for enterprise organizations and startups. Expertise in AI-driven development, Node, TypeScript, cloud infrastructure, and CI/CD pipelines. Team player who encourages a collaborative environment with a strong focus on delivering quality products.

bullets: Built and managed **AWS** infrastructure for internal projects, implementing resource provisioning, networking, observability, secret management and secure sign-in for short-lived CLI credentials.
Developed internal AI tools and products integrating **LLMs**, **RAG** and automated workflows, including data ingestion pipelines, document summarization and AI content generation.

Built AI call analysis tools that turn call center recordings into structured data, i.e. call summaries, identified call events and calls tagged against defined **LLM** tagging criteria, using **RabbitMQ** and asynchronous workers for event-driven processing.
Designed **agentic development** patterns with **Claude Code**, including context management.

Migrated manual **GCP** infrastructure management to **infrastructure as code** with **Terraform**, covering compute, storage and messaging, and implemented **automated deployment and test pipelines** across local development, staging and production environments with per-environment secrets.
Wrote end-to-end tests to prevent UI regressions; monitored production with health checks and Slack alerts.
Implemented performance optimizations, reducing dashboard load times from **2s+ to ~200 ms** via cached pre-computed tables, query fixes and indexes.
Built REST APIs and robust automated ingestion of third-party pricing data.
Developed internal management and admin solutions, working with leadership to automate the HR system and reduce manual reporting work.

Built reusable internal tools and libraries with standardized interfaces, and managed GitLab repositories and **CI/CD pipelines** for employee services, streamlining development and reducing boilerplate.

Modernized legacy banking web and mobile apps with **Angular** and **Express**; rebuilt **REST API** services spanning 200+ endpoints, reworking backend endpoints with **Java** and **Spring Boot** and building **Python** microservices with **Flask** and microfrontends.
Built secure login for a cross-platform mobile banking app—challenge authentication, OTP login, and **session management**.
Built a reusable component library with UI designers for consistency across client applications.
Established test environments and wrote extensive unit tests to meet the banking client's **90% test coverage** requirement.
Provided **technical leadership** through training and developer support; led UI architecture for a **React** proof of concept.
Automated manual QA work with Python scripts that scrape and parse application logs, **saving hundreds of hours weekly**.

Worked in **Agile** teams across client engagements, grooming sprints and implementing user stories; partnered with product owners to shape data flows for new requirements and to review the application for UI/UX enhancements, then implemented them.
Open source maintainer of several **applications**, **API services**, **Docker images** and **npm packages**.
Design, develop and maintain code through **agent orchestration workflows** in **Claude Code**, backed by custom skills and **guardrails** that keep unattended agent runs safe.
Provision and operate **multi-cloud** and self-hosted infrastructure with Terraform; build local environments and automated deployment and testing **CI/CD pipelines** with **GitHub Actions**.
